description: §6.8.4 — `tare` is a RESERVED IDENTIFIER, exactly as `reset` is (§6.8.2). Declaring a local `function tare() {...}` shadows the builtin and fires E-RESERVED-IDENTIFIER (compile error, §34). Sibling of reactive-reset-reserved-identifier; pins the enforcement at all four ast-builder function/fn declaration-parse sites.
rationale: Reserving the name is what lets the expression-parser lift `tare(...)` into a distinct AST node without ambiguity, and what stops a local declaration from silently shadowing the keyword at some call sites but not others. Adoption cost was measured before landing: `git grep -nw tare` over every tracked `.scrml` returned ZERO, so the reservation breaks no existing source. The `function` form is used here (a `fn` form would additionally fire E-FN-003 for the reactive write), mirroring the reset case exactly.
